items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: He took me to Flint (Michigan) one time to hear Cab (Calloway) in person... I know Cab was out in front; he was singin' and doin' his thing

ctx.x: Well, I had records, my father-- you know--then every once in a while he'd take me out. He took me to Flint (Michigan) one time to hear Cab (Calloway) in person and I heard Hilton Jefferson...there was all the other guys in the band, but I was saxophone conscious. So, I'll never forget this, there was a dance in Flint and my father took me over there and there was Cab's band and there was Chu Berry, one of my idols, and there was Hilton Jefferson. So they played 'Body and Soul' and Hilton Jefferson got up and…
So this trip to Flint to see Cab's band...
